Title: Track Preferences — First Choices Approved 🎉
Message:
Great news for the EU-HEM cohort: the Consortium Board has approved everyone’s first-choice track.

Although one of the tracks received more preferences than the previously communicated maximum capacity, the programme explored ways to accommodate the additional students, including larger classrooms and available teaching capacity.

These arrangements were successfully made, meaning that all students can continue in their preferred track.

We hope everyone is excited for the next stage of the EU-HEM journey!

Based on the official programme update from the EU-HEM International Programme Coordination.

Title: Welcome to the EU-HEM Student Hub — Beta
Message:
The EU-HEM Student Hub is now open for beta testing! 🎉

Take a look around, explore the available resources and features, and help us improve the platform.

If you notice anything confusing, missing, or not working as expected — or if you have an idea for a new feature — we’d love to hear from you.

You can share your feedback and suggestions through the Contact page, in our cohort WhatsApp group, or simply reach out to me directly.

This is an early version of the Hub, and your feedback will help shape what comes next.
